## Data Sources

We use three data sources from three different organizations: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, The Museum of Modern Art, and the Conflict Catalog (Peter Brecke, Georgia Tech).

### Source A: The Met Open Access

![Raw Met data: header row and first rows of MetObjects.csv](images/met_raw.png){width="100%" fig-alt="First rows of the Met Open Access CSV"}

**Issues reading this source:** `Object Date` is free text (e.g. "ca. 1650", "19th century"), so we drop it and use the numeric `Object Begin Date` / `Object End Date` columns instead. Many columns are more than 50% empty.

### Source B: MoMA Collection

![Raw MoMA data: header row and first rows of Artworks.csv](images/moma_raw.png){width="100%" fig-alt="First rows of the MoMA Artworks CSV"}

**Issues reading this source:** `ArtistBio`, `Nationality`, and `Gender` are wrapped in parentheses, and `Date` mixes formats ("1896", "1976-77", "c. 1917").

### Source C: Conflict Catalog

![Raw Conflict Catalog data: header row and first rows](images/conflict_raw.png){width="100%" fig-alt="First rows of the Conflict Catalog spreadsheet"}

**Issues reading this source:** the `Name` column has the years embedded in the conflict name, fatality counts are often missing, and `Common Name` is blank for most rows.

## Course set up

```{r}
# Checks that R and each package are installed and new enough for this course.
# Stops with a list of everything that needs fixing, and how to fix it.
check_course_versions <- function(required, area) {
  problems <- character(0)
  to_install <- character(0)
  found <- character(0)
  for (name in names(required)) {
    need <- required[[name]]
    if (name == "R") {
      have <- getRversion()
      if (have < need) {
        problems <- c(problems, sprintf(
          "R is version %s; this course needs %s or newer. Install the current R from https://cran.r-project.org/ (see https://howisonlab.github.io/datawrangling/current/rtidyverse/rstudio_installation.html), then reinstall your packages.",
          have, need))
      }
      found <- c(found, paste("R", have))
    } else if (!nzchar(system.file(package = name))) {
      problems <- c(problems, sprintf("%s is not installed.", name))
      to_install <- c(to_install, name)
    } else {
      have <- packageVersion(name)
      if (have < need) {
        problems <- c(problems, sprintf(
          "%s is version %s; this course needs %s or newer.", name, have, need))
        to_install <- c(to_install, name)
      } else if (isNamespaceLoaded(name) && getNamespaceVersion(name) != have) {
        problems <- c(problems, sprintf(
          "%s %s is installed, but this R session is still using %s. Restart R.",
          name, have, getNamespaceVersion(name)))
      }
      found <- c(found, paste(name, have))
    }
  }
  if (length(problems) > 0) {
    fix <- "In RStudio choose Session > Restart R"
    if (length(to_install) > 0) {
      fix <- paste0(fix, ", then run this in the Console:\n  install.packages(c(",
                    paste0('"', to_install, '"', collapse = ", "), "))\n")
    }
    stop("Course setup (", area, ") found problems:\n  - ",
         paste(problems, collapse = "\n  - "), "\n\n",
         fix, "\nThen run the setup chunk(s) again.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  cat("Course setup OK (", area, "): ", paste(found, collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
}

check_course_versions(c(
  R = "4.5.0",         # CRAN builds Mac/Windows packages for the current and previous R only
  tidyverse = "2.0.0",
  dplyr = "1.2.0",     # recode_values() and replace_values()
  tidyr = "1.3.0",     # separate_wider_delim()
  gt = "1.0.0",        # needed by gtExtras
  gtExtras = "0.6.1"   # works with ggplot2 4
), "R")

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
```

```{r}
# needs check_course_versions() from the Course setup (R) chunk
check_course_versions(c(
  DBI = "1.0.0",
  duckdb = "1.5.5"     # duckdb(shared_home = FALSE)
), "SQL")

library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
options(duckdb.enable_rstudio_connection_pane = TRUE)

# a temporary in-memory database, nothing saved to a file
drv <- duckdb(shared_home = FALSE)
con <- dbConnect(drv)
```

```{r}
# needs check_course_versions() from the Course setup (R) chunk
check_course_versions(c(
  reticulate = "1.41.0"  # py_require()
), "Python")

library(reticulate)
# reticulate sets up a Python with these packages for us (the first run downloads them).
# This must run before any python chunk: if Python has already started, restart R first.
py_require(c(
  "pandas>=3.0",         # pd.col() in assign
  "numpy",
  "pyjanitor"            # clean_names() for snake_case column names
), python_version = ">=3.11")
```

## R Tidyverse

### Load Source A: The Met

```{r}
#| label: r-load-met
# guess_max: some columns look numeric for thousands of rows, then turn to text
met_raw <- read_csv("data/MetObjects.csv", guess_max = 100000)

glimpse(met_raw)
```

```{r}
#| label: r-preview-met
met_raw |>
  select(`Object ID`, Title, `Object Date`, `Object Begin Date`,
         `Object End Date`, Medium, Classification) |>
  head(5)
```

### Load Source B: MoMA

```{r}
#| label: r-load-moma
moma_raw <- read_csv("data/Artworks.csv")

glimpse(moma_raw)
```

```{r}
#| label: r-preview-moma
moma_raw |>
  select(Title, Artist, ArtistBio, Nationality, Gender, Date, Medium) |>
  head(5)
```

## DuckDB SQL

```{r}
#| label: sql-excel-extension
# DuckDB needs its excel extension to read the Conflict Catalog .xlsx
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL excel;")
dbExecute(con, "LOAD excel;")
```

### Load Source A: The Met

```{sql}
#| label: sql-load-met
#| connection: con
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE met_raw AS
SELECT *
FROM read_csv('data/MetObjects.csv', sample_size = -1);
```

```{sql}
#| label: sql-preview-met
#| connection: con
SELECT "Object ID", Title, "Object Date", "Object Begin Date",
       "Object End Date", Medium, Classification
FROM met_raw
LIMIT 5;
```

### Load Source B: MoMA

```{sql}
#| label: sql-load-moma
#| connection: con

FROM read_csv('data/Artworks.csv');
```

```{sql}
#| label: sql-preview-moma
#| connection: con
SELECT Title, Artist, ArtistBio, Nationality, Gender, Date, Medium
FROM moma_raw
LIMIT 5;
```
